info.title: 91 client API
info.description: The official and custom frontends use this contract. API versioning is reported by /api/server; current resource paths remain /api, /admin/api and /p. Page routing belongs to the client. Setup is public only until the first administrator is created. Management endpoints always verify administrator permissions. See docs/CUSTOM_FRONTEND.md for deployment, playback and task workflows.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Required when feedToken is empty. Listing applies q, tag and sort; other kinds ignore these filters. Continuations use the existing snapshot.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum items in this batch.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Use zero for the first batch, then the returned nextCursor.

parameters.name: feedToken
parameters.description: Omit for the first batch. Continue with the returned token; a 410 response requires starting a new snapshot.

410.description: Feed snapshot expired. Restart without a token and with cursor=0.

get.description: Start with kind=listing, recommend or latest and cursor=0, omitting feedToken. Continue with the returned token and nextCursor. A 410 means the snapshot expired: discard the token and restart. Abandon old requests when filters change.
